title: Source Table Metadata
description: Schema for session/source_table_metadata.json — per-source-table type classification. Keyed by 'db.table' (e.g. 'e_ilp_db.account_wm').

source_table_type.description: Classified type based on audit column heuristic. NonTransactional_SCD2 = entity-state with SCD2 history columns. NonTransactional_SCD1 = entity-state with dw_lod_tmp/dw_upd_lod_tmp only (no eff_start_date/eff_end_date/active). Must be resolved before generation — ambiguous sources trigger HALT for user clarification.

classification_confidence.description: HIGH = definitive H0/H0b match; MEDIUM = partial audit column match; LOW = fallback/no match.

classification_heuristic.description: Which heuristic rule matched. VOL = source_volumetrics table_type (analyst-declared in mapping Excel, highest priority). DK = domain knowledge. UA = user_asked (HALT triggered, user provided answer). *-map = mapping document fallback.

classification_source.description: Where the classification was derived from. 'source_volumetrics' = analyst-declared table_type from Source Volumetrics tab in mapping Excel (highest priority). 'domain_knowledge' = explicit type hint in domain knowledge file. 'mapping_document' = inferred from audit columns visible in mapping source column references.

audit_columns_present.description: Boolean flags for each audit column's presence. Null when classification is from volumetrics or domain knowledge (presence unknown).

eff_start_date.description: SCD2 effective start date column present. Null when presence is unknown.

eff_end_date.description: SCD2 effective end date column present. Null when presence is unknown.

active.description: SCD2 active flag column present. Null when presence is unknown.

dw_upd_lod_tmp.description: Datawarehouse update load timestamp column present (SCD2 indicator). Null when presence is unknown.

dw_bus_dt.description: Datawarehouse business date column present (Transactional indicator). Null when presence is unknown.

dw_lod_tmp.description: Datawarehouse load timestamp column present (Transactional indicator). Null when presence is unknown.

full_column_list.description: Reserved for future use. Currently always empty array.

classified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when classification was performed.
